title: Onboarding funnel metrics + dashboards (guided onboarding checklist)
creator: Nikhil Sharma
project: Guided onboarding + first production launch checklist (Hosted API, Phase 1)
description:
We need a canonical onboarding funnel and a small set of dashboards to measure whether guided onboarding reduces time-to-first-success (TTFS) and increases conversion to a first production launch. This issue defines metric requirements, segmentation/cohorting rules, and how we correlate completion with retention/usage (without collecting prompt content).

This is the metrics + dashboards workstream only. Event emission/state model are tracked elsewhere (ENG-23112 / ENG-23111), but the dashboard requirements must be stable before Beta so we can evaluate step changes and ordering.

Primary users: Product (Nikhil/Marissa), DevEx (Alex/Monica/Elliot), Telemetry platform (Logan/Nadia), SRE (telemetry health), Support (validate we’re reducing common failure modes).

Links:
- Event schema (draft): sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/observability-standards/onboarding-telemetry-event-schema-v1.json
- Checklist PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/guided-onboarding-checklist-prd-2026-01.json
- Privacy review: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/onboarding-telemetry-privacy-review.json
content:
## Goals
1) Provide a single source of truth for onboarding funnel performance during Beta and GA.
2) Enable step-level diagnosis (drop-off, time spent, error correlation) so we can iterate on checklist ordering/copy and docs deep links.
3) Measure whether checklist completion correlates with retention and usage growth (and whether it’s causal enough to justify GA).

## Non-goals / Out of scope
- Dedicated/Private onboarding metrics (Phase 2).
- Deep attribution modeling across marketing channels beyond basic UTM + signup source.
- User-level surveillance: we should remain org/project-level by default, with user_id only where strictly needed for UX (and only in privacy-approved tables).

## Definitions (must align across Product/Eng/Analytics)
### Entities
- Org: customer workspace.
- Project: Redwood project (where API keys and usage are scoped). Funnel should be computed at the project level, then roll up to org.
- Environment: test vs prod (based on API key label/environment + gateway classification).

### Key success metrics (headline)
1) TTFS (Time to First Success): time from signup (or first Console session) to first successful Hosted API response.
   - Default: signup_timestamp -> first_api_success_timestamp (per project; for brand new orgs).
   - Secondary: api_key_created_timestamp -> first_api_success_timestamp.
2) Time to First Production Launch (TTFPL): time from first successful response -> first “production launch achieved” marker.
   - Note: definition depends on PM-483. For Beta we will likely use a pragmatic proxy + a stricter definition as a secondary view.
3) Checklist completion rate: % of eligible new projects completing each step and the overall checklist within 7 days.

### Retention / usage metrics (for correlation)
We need at least two retention definitions because “retained” for inference looks different by customer maturity.
- D7 active: org/project has >0 successful requests on day 7 (UTC), excluding “console-only” events.
- D30 active: same at day 30.
- Repeat usage: # of active days with successful requests within 14 days after first success.
- Growth proxy: total successful requests or total billable tokens in days 1–7 and 1–30 (bucketed/quantized; avoid exposing sensitive raw values broadly).

## Funnel requirements
### Funnel scope
Phase 1: Hosted API + self-serve onboarding only.
Cohort for primary funnel reporting:
- New orgs created after checklist beta start date
- Console checklist feature flag = ON at any point within first 24h of org creation
- Exclude internal Redwood orgs / test tenants

### Canonical funnel steps (v1)
Final step list must match Console checklist ordering; for dashboards we need stable step IDs.
Proposed v1 step IDs (subject to PM-483 signoff):
1) created_api_key_test (created a test key)
2) first_successful_request (first 2xx response from Hosted API)
3) first_streaming_session (first successful streaming response; handle reconnect edge cases)
4) viewed_usage_dashboard (visited usage analytics page)
5) understood_rate_limits (clicked through to quota/rate limit docs/settings OR acknowledged step)
6) created_api_key_prod (created prod key / set environment=prod)
7) production_safeguards_configured (proxy marker; see below)
8) production_launch_achieved (definition TBD)

Notes on “production_safeguards_configured” (proxy):
- For Beta, we may need a hybrid marker:
  - Console acknowledgement of safeguards step + doc clickthrough
  - Optional validator signals (presence of request_id headers, retries configured in SDK snippet, non-default timeout) if available in gateway metadata
- We must clearly label which steps are auto-validated vs self-attested.

### Completion + time-to-complete
For each step, dashboards must provide:
- Step completion rate (unique projects)
- Drop-off rate from previous step
- Median / p75 / p90 time from prior step and from funnel start
- Distribution view (log scale option) and breakdowns by cohorts

### Cohorting / segmentation (minimum set)
Dashboards must support slicing by:
- Checklist experience: feature flag ON vs OFF (control)
- SDK language: python | typescript | go | other/unknown (derived from user agent / SDK header)
- Region: request region or Console region (coarse)
- Account age: hours since org creation at first success
- Acquisition source: signup source + docs UTM (from Console deep links; see DES-115)
- Plan/tier: self-serve vs sales-assisted (if available), and whether they later move to Dedicated interest (optional)

### Cohort definitions (must be explicitly documented on dashboard)
- New user cohort: first_seen_date (org creation) within a week.
- Beta cohort: allowlisted orgs and % rollout orgs should be taggable separately (to avoid skew when we iterate quickly).
- Exclusions: internal orgs, automated load test orgs, suspicious/fraud orgs (if flagged).

## Dashboard deliverables
We need 3 dashboard surfaces + 1 “telemetry health” view.

### Dashboard A: Onboarding Funnel Overview (exec-friendly)
Audience: PM/Exec sponsor/DevEx.
Must include:
- Funnel chart: # of projects reaching each step
- TTFS and TTFPL med/p75 trend by week
- Checklist completion within 1 day / 7 days trend
- Control vs treatment comparison (flag OFF vs ON)
- Top 3 step drop-offs (latest 7d)

### Dashboard B: Step Diagnostics (iteration tool)
Audience: PM/Design/Docs/SDK teams.
Per step:
- Completion % and median time from previous step
- Top linked docs pages from that step (by URL + UTM campaign)
- Error correlation (for steps tied to API usage): 401/429/5xx rates before and after step completion window
- Qualitative notes field (link out to Support issues / known failures doc)

### Dashboard C: Time-to-complete Distributions
Audience: PM + Eng.
Must include:
- TTFS distribution (p50/p75/p90/p95) by cohort
- Time between key milestones:
  - signup -> api_key_created
  - api_key_created -> first_success
  - first_success -> first_streaming
  - first_success -> created_prod_key
- Ability to filter to “no first success within 24h” and see their top errors/behaviors

### Dashboard D: Retention correlation
Audience: PM + Growth + Exec sponsor.
Must include:
- D7 and D30 active rates by checklist completion bucket (0–25%, 25–50%, 50–75%, 75–100%, production_launch_achieved)
- Usage growth (bucketed tokens/requests) by completion bucket
- Caveats section: correlation != causation, control/treatment limitations, instrumentation lag
- Optionally: survival curve for time-to-churn proxy (no successful requests after day N)

### Telemetry Health View (SRE + telemetry platform)
Audience: Logan/Nadia + SRE.
Must include:
- Event ingestion volume by region (expected vs actual)
- % events failing validation / dropped by allowlist
- Pipeline delay (p50/p95) from emit -> available in warehouse
- Dedupe rate / idempotency collisions
- Alert thresholds (tie to ENG-23125)

## Data requirements
### Source events
All dashboards must be derived from onboarding telemetry event schema v1.
Required properties (minimum):
- event_name
- event_time
- org_id
- project_id
- user_id (optional; only if privacy-approved)
- checklist_step_id (for step events)
- checklist_version
- feature_flag_state (on/off + cohort tag)
- sdk_language (if known)
- region
- request_outcome (success/failure class) for API-related validators
- error_class for failures (401/429/timeout/5xx/unknown)

### Identity + joins
- We need a stable “project created” timestamp (or first_seen) to anchor time-to-complete.
- Join to metering/usage tables for retention correlation must be at org_id/project_id level.
- No prompt content, no response content, no raw headers beyond allowlisted telemetry fields.

### Latency + freshness
For Beta iteration, dashboards must update at least hourly. Daily rollups are insufficient for step ordering/copy experiments.

## Instrumentation caveats (must be visible on dashboards)
- Step completion may be delayed (e.g., first_success validator computed asynchronously from gateway logs/metrics).
- Streaming step is sensitive to disconnect handling; define what counts as “success” (see ENG-23114).
- Some steps are “acknowledged” rather than auto-validated; separate them visually to avoid false confidence.

## Acceptance criteria
1) Funnel Overview dashboard exists and is usable for weekly Beta review.
2) Step Diagnostics dashboard can identify the largest drop-off step and a plausible reason (docs click, error class) without ad hoc queries.
3) Retention correlation dashboard can answer: “Do users completing >=75% of steps have higher D7 active rate than <25%?” with filters for control/treatment.
4) Telemetry Health view can detect a missing-region incident within the same day (and shows where events are being dropped).
5) Metric definitions are documented and linked in the dashboard description (TTFS, TTFPL, step IDs, cohort rules).

## Open questions
- Final definition for production_launch_achieved (depends on PM-483). If definition changes after Beta start, we need versioned metrics.
- Where do we store the canonical “org created” timestamp for onboarding anchoring? Console auth service vs billing vs org DB.
- What is the minimally invasive way to infer SDK language reliably (SDK header vs user agent parsing)?
- Can we safely bucket usage metrics for broad visibility while still enabling analysis?

## Proposed owners
- Product requirements: Nikhil Sharma / Marissa Cole
- Dashboard implementation: Mei Lin
- Event schema + data plumbing: Nadia Rahman / Logan Wright
- Privacy signoff: Marcus Lin / Michael Grant

## Next steps
1) Mei to draft dashboard layouts + required fields list and review with Nikhil/Marissa.
2) Align cohort tagging with feature flag implementation (ENG-23118).
3) Confirm event allowlist supports all required properties (ENG-23120).
4) Schedule weekly Beta metrics review cadence and decide what constitutes a “win” for GA.

2026-01-29 (Marissa Cole): For Beta, we must show treatment vs control clearly. Feature flag cohorts: allowlist vs % rollout vs default-off. Please ensure cohort_tag is present and filterable; we have seen skew when we iterate quickly on copy.

2026-02-03 (Logan Wright): Telemetry health dashboard should be on-call friendly. We should reuse the existing pipeline delay and event-drop alerts patterns; I’ll sync with SRE on thresholds. Also note: some validators update state server-side; we need a deterministic “step_completed_at” timestamp emitted when backend marks completion.

2026-02-07 (Nikhil Sharma): Adding requirement: for Step Diagnostics, please include 'top 401 causes' split by prod vs test key misuse if we can infer it from gateway (ties to SUP-9244 pain). If not possible, at least segment 401s by whether a key was created in the last hour.

2026-02-11 (Mei Lin): Updated spec to include bucketed usage metrics (requests/tokens) for broader sharing. Waiting on privacy review guidance for who can see unbucketed values. Targeting first usable funnel overview by 2026-02-18 for Beta readiness review.
